# CHANNEL INSIGHTS — IT CAFETERIA (data file, not rules)

Used by Multi_Channel_Content_Agent.md: Step 4b (working title + hook), the topic choice, video cross-references and the duplicate check (section 8), and the YT Automation category (section 9).
This file holds data only — numbers copied from analytics screenshots, the published-videos library (section 8) and the YT Automation series roadmap and progress (section 9). Nothing here is a rule.

**How it is updated (weekly):** send the screenshots listed in section 0 in any chat and ask: "Channel_Insights.md update karo". Claude first lists every number it read from the images and waits for your "ok" (screenshots can be misread), then rewrites this file. Only the newest week is added; older weeks are rolled into section 3. Section 9 is not rolled weekly: it changes only when a chapter is finished or the roadmap is edited. **Memory blocks (v3.41):** the agent prints a Memory block after each story; Waqar saves the blocks and sends them once a day (evening), and Claude adds them to section 8 ("Added after the screenshots") and updates section 9 if a chapter was finished.

**Last updated:** 24 Oct 2026    **Weeks covered:** TikTok 1 week (Oct 10–16, 2026) · YouTube 1 snapshot of 28 days (Sep 21–Oct 18, 2026)
**Data strength:** Thin (YouTube monthly audience 575; TikTok about 600 viewers in the week) — if Thin, the agent keeps confidence Low and treats everything below as a weak signal, never a rule.

## 9. YT Automation series — roadmap and progress
A lecture-style course about YouTube automation, made chapter by chapter in 16:9. Updated only when a chapter is finished or the roadmap is changed.
- **Status (Oct 24, 2026):** Chapters 1–10 covered (Chapters 9 and 10 completed, per Waqar). **Next chapter: Chapter 11.**
- **Series rules (from Waqar):** roadmap first; no cap on the number of chapters; every topic covered completely; a chapter that does not fit in one video is split into Parts (each production part 10–15 scenes).
